challenges.says: The cancelled-ending criterion says "Search canceled" with the counts, but the rule only says "Search canceled: ..." and states no counts, so the criterion adds detail the rule does not give.

The criterion for rule 80544887789558031281 adds that the search dialog opens empty or running a new search, which is about starting a search, not picking a hit, and belongs to neither this story's title nor its steps.

The last criterion (nothing is returned when no search has run or the last hit has been passed) restates an internal return value of the next-hit rule in terms a product owner cannot act on, and overlaps the previous criterion about Find Next.

Every criterion has no cited rule (from is empty) and the criteria do not say why, yet each states behaviour no rule or decision gives: that no new search starts, that the earlier choice is reselected if still listed, and the exact "No search has been run yet..." message with nothing opening.
The story has no components and reuses action block-64273399884973341208 already built by the first story, so it covers that action twice and has nothing of its own to build.
